stories.headline: Getty Images will go private in a deal with Koch
stories.summary: Getty Images, an American visual images company, says it will go private in a restructuring deal with Koch, Inc. Koch will invest $533 million, and Getty Images is expected to file for prepackaged Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in the coming weeks. In July the company had moved to end a planned $3.7 billion merger with Shutterstock.

stories.headline: All four engines are on the Artemis III core stage
stories.summary: NASA has installed all four RS-25 engines on the core stage of the Artemis III rocket. The twin solid rocket boosters beside it will provide more than 75 percent of the rocket’s thrust at liftoff from Launch Pad 39B. In the coming months NASA will roll the part-built rocket out of the Vehicle Assembly Building for a test of propellant loading.

stories.headline: A Jurassic hunter that looked something like an otter
stories.summary: Researchers have described a furry Jurassic hunter named Megacauda sungei. It measured about half a metre from nose to tail, which made it remarkably large among its Jurassic relatives, and it caught prey in the water with backward-curving cusps on its teeth. With short fur and a broad, flattened tail, it would have looked something like an otter, a beaver or a platypus.
